title: 生物安全柜的清洁与废物
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/073_生物安全柜的清洁与废物.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/073_生物安全柜的清洁与废物/src.py

points.K1: 收尾也要照规程：风机一直开着
points.K2: 盖好容器，物品由轻到重消毒
points.K3: 样品出柜：外表去污或装二级容器
points.K4: 吸水垫向内折，柜内表面再擦一遍
points.K5: 柜内废物容器：开工前备好，吸头当锐器
points.K6: 不超过四分之三就封口
points.K8: 内袋扎紧补消毒，外袋包住再扎
points.K9: 袋子破了：柜内加套，不拿出去
points.K10: 外表消毒、换手套，再移出柜外
points.K11: 送去灭菌：袋口按灭菌规程处理
points.K12: 风机再运行，关灯关窗，签登记
points.K13: 定期检测认证，维护职责分明

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在生物安全柜旁，手拿湿巾和废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biosafety cabinet holding disinfectant wipes and a biohazard bag.
shots.narration: 这一课讲生物安全柜的清洁与废物。
overlay: 生物安全柜的清洁与废物

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰做完实验，伸手先关风机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes his work and reaches to switch off the cabinet fan.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完实验，伸手就要关风机。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拎着敞口的废物袋往柜外走，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the young male student carries an open biohazard bag out of the cabinet; crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 废物袋敞着口就往外拎。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指指核查表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to a checklist on the cabinet.
shots.narration: 小研说：收尾和开工一样要讲规程。

shots.section_title: 收尾也要照规程：风机一直开着
shots.scene: 物品和柜子两个图标都打上去污勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons for the items and for the cabinet itself, each receiving a cleaning check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 结束时，物品要去污，柜子也要去污。
overlay: 收尾也要照规程：风机一直开着

shots.section_title: 收尾也要照规程：风机一直开着
shots.scene: 风机图标亮着，气流箭头往柜里吸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the cabinet fan icon stays on while airflow arrows keep pulling inward. No text.
shots.narration: 整个清理过程，风机一直开着。

shots.section_title: 收尾也要照规程：风机一直开着
shots.scene: 关掉风机，柜内气溶胶飘出，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the fan switched off and mist drifting out of the cabinet front; crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 气流在，防护才在，别急着关。

shots.section_title: 收尾也要照规程：风机一直开着
shots.scene: 规程书里列出摆放、溢洒、废物、去污几页
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a procedure book opening to pages with icons for layout, spills, waste and cleaning. No text.
shots.narration: 废物、去污、溢洒，都写进规程。

shots.section_title: 盖好容器，物品由轻到重消毒
shots.scene: 【实拍】柜内逐个拧紧样品管盖、盖好培养皿（空管、清水）
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet, gloved hands tighten tube caps and close dish lids one by one. Empty tubes.
shots.narration: 第一步：所有容器都盖好。
overlay: 盖好容器，物品由轻到重消毒

shots.section_title: 盖好容器，物品由轻到重消毒
shots.scene: 用开工时同一种消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same disinfectant bottle shown at the start and at the end of work. No text.
shots.narration: 用开工时同一种指定消毒剂。

shots.section_title: 盖好容器，物品由轻到重消毒
shots.scene: 【实拍】湿巾从污染最轻的物品擦起，逐件擦拭（清水演示）
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands wipe items one by one with a wet towel, starting from the least contaminated one.
shots.narration: 从污染最轻的物品擦起，由轻到重。

shots.section_title: 盖好容器，物品由轻到重消毒
shots.scene: 表面保持湿润，计时器转动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wet surfaces with a timer icon counting the contact time. No text.
shots.narration: 保持湿润，作用时间够，消毒才有效。

shots.section_title: 盖好容器，物品由轻到重消毒
shots.scene: 时间到后擦干，留柜物品移到清洁一侧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: residue wiped dry, and items that stay are moved to the clean side of the cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 时间到了擦干，留下的放清洁一侧。

shots.section_title: 样品出柜：外表去污或装二级容器
shots.scene: 样品管外表擦拭后放进带盖的二级容器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wiped sample tube placed into a lidded secondary container that is also wiped. No text.
shots.narration: 样品出柜，外表去污或装进二级容器。
overlay: 样品出柜：外表去污或装二级容器

shots.section_title: 样品出柜：外表去污或装二级容器
shots.scene: 其余要拿出的东西移到柜旁推车上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves the other cleaned items onto a cart beside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 其余要拿出的东西，移到推车上。

shots.section_title: 吸水垫向内折，柜内表面再擦一遍
shots.scene: 【实拍】抓住吸水垫外角向内对折，脏面包在里面（干净吸水垫演示）
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands grab the outer corners of an absorbent pad and fold it inward, dirty side inside.
shots.narration: 吸水垫抓外角向内折，脏面包在里面。
overlay: 吸水垫向内折，柜内表面再擦一遍

shots.section_title: 吸水垫向内折，柜内表面再擦一遍
shots.scene: 折好的垫子放进废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the folded pad dropped into the biohazard bag inside the cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 折好丢进柜内的废物袋。

shots.section_title: 吸水垫向内折，柜内表面再擦一遍
shots.scene: 【实拍】湿巾依次擦侧壁、后壁、前窗内侧、台面（清水演示）
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands wipe the side walls, back wall, inner sash and work surface with wet towels.
shots.narration: 清空后，侧壁、后壁、前窗内侧都擦。

shots.section_title: 吸水垫向内折，柜内表面再擦一遍
shots.scene: 前窗玻璃内侧发光提示，柜内喷雾打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the inner side of the sash glass highlighted as an often-missed spot; a spray mist crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别漏前窗内侧，用湿巾擦，不喷雾。

shots.section_title: 柜内废物容器：开工前备好，吸头当锐器
shots.scene: 开工前废物桶套好两层袋，消毒剂放手边
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: before work, a waste bin lined with two bags and a disinfectant bottle placed nearby. No text.
shots.narration: 收尾从开工就开始：桶套两层袋。
overlay: 柜内废物容器：开工前备好，吸头当锐器

shots.section_title: 柜内废物容器：开工前备好，吸头当锐器
shots.scene: 用过的吸头像针一样被归入锐器类
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a used pipette tip grouped with needles under a sharps icon. No text.
shots.narration: 在柜里，用过的吸头也按锐器对待。

shots.section_title: 柜内废物容器：开工前备好，吸头当锐器
shots.scene: 按规程在容器里先加消毒液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: disinfectant poured into a waste container according to a procedure book. No text.
shots.narration: 按规程，容器里可先加消毒液。

shots.section_title: 柜内废物容器：开工前备好，吸头当锐器
shots.scene: 乙醇瓶当浸泡液打叉，旁边火焰和挥发图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ethanol bottle used as a soaking liquid, with evaporation and flame icons; crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 乙醇易挥发易燃，不宜当浸泡液。

shots.section_title: 不超过四分之三就封口
shots.scene: 废物桶水位线到四分之三处亮起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a waste bin with a fill line glowing at three quarters full. No text.
shots.narration: 废物装到四分之三前，就要封口。
overlay: 不超过四分之三就封口

shots.section_title: 不超过四分之三就封口
shots.scene: 装得冒尖压不下去，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an overfilled waste bin with items pushed down by hand; crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别装满，更别用手往下压。

shots.section_title: 废物在柜内装双层袋
shots.scene: 柜内气流罩住废物袋，污染不外跑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: downflow air covering a waste bag inside the cabinet, keeping contamination in. No text.
shots.narration: 废物在柜里装好袋，再拿出来。

shots.section_title: 废物在柜内装双层袋
shots.scene: 两层袋，一层被戳破，另一层兜住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inner bag pierced by a tip while the outer bag still holds everything. No text.
shots.narration: 两层袋，一层戳破还有一层兜着。

shots.section_title: 废物在柜内装双层袋
shots.scene: 先湿润手套和容器外面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gloves and the outside of the waste container wiped with disinfectant before closing. No text.
shots.narration: 动手收口前，先消毒手套和容器外面。

shots.section_title: 废物在柜内装双层袋
shots.scene: 往内袋里挤少量消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wash bottle squeezes a little disinfectant into the inner bag. No text.
shots.narration: 收口前往内袋加少量消毒剂。

shots.section_title: 内袋扎紧补消毒，外袋包住再扎
shots.scene: 【实拍】内袋口轻轻收拢、拧成一股，不挤压袋子（空袋演示）
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands gently gather the inner bag neck and twist it into one strand without squeezing the bag.
shots.narration: 内袋口轻轻收拢拧成一股，别挤袋子。
overlay: 内袋扎紧补消毒，外袋包住再扎

shots.section_title: 内袋扎紧补消毒，外袋包住再扎
shots.scene: 挤压袋子，空气带着气溶胶喷出，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bag squeezed hard pushes air and mist out of its neck; crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别把袋里空气挤出来，会带出气溶胶。

shots.section_title: 内袋扎紧补消毒，外袋包住再扎
shots.scene: 【实拍】扎带扎住袋口，再缠一道胶带（空袋演示）
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands secure the twisted bag neck with a cable tie and wrap tape around it.
shots.narration: 用扎带扎住，再缠上胶带。

shots.section_title: 内袋扎紧补消毒，外袋包住再扎
shots.scene: 扎口处再擦一遍消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the tied neck of the inner bag wiped again with disinfectant. No text.
shots.narration: 扎口处再消毒，手碰过的最易污染。

shots.section_title: 内袋扎紧补消毒，外袋包住再扎
shots.scene: 【实拍】外袋从桶沿翻起，把内袋整个包住，同样拧紧扎好（空袋演示）
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands lift the outer bag from the bin rim, wrap the inner bag inside, then twist and tie it.
shots.narration: 翻起外袋包住内袋，同样扎紧。

shots.section_title: 内袋扎紧补消毒，外袋包住再扎
shots.scene: 轻拉扎口确认牢固，多余部分理齐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand gently tugs the tied neck to confirm it holds, and the loose end is tidied. No text.
shots.narration: 理齐扎口，轻轻拉一拉确认扎牢。

shots.section_title: 袋子破了：柜内加套，不拿出去
shots.scene: 袋子破口渗液，停下的手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a torn bag leaking liquid inside the cabinet; a hand pauses above it. No text.
shots.narration: 袋子破了渗漏，先停下，别拿出柜外。
overlay: 袋子破了：柜内加套，不拿出去

shots.section_title: 袋子破了：柜内加套，不拿出去
shots.scene: 在柜内外面再套一只新袋扎紧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new bag slipped over the torn bag inside the cabinet and tied. No text.
shots.narration: 在柜内外面再套一只新袋，扎紧。

shots.section_title: 袋子破了：柜内加套，不拿出去
shots.scene: 漏液盖纸巾倒消毒剂，手套沾污就换
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: paper towels laid over the leak and disinfectant applied; contaminated gloves replaced. No text.
shots.narration: 漏液盖纸巾加消毒剂，手套脏了就换。

shots.section_title: 袋子破了：柜内加套，不拿出去
shots.scene: 小研报告老周并登记
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man and fills in a record sheet.
shots.narration: 处理完，报告负责人并记录。

shots.section_title: 外表消毒、换手套，再移出柜外
shots.scene: 双层袋提出来，袋上有生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the double bag lifted out of the bin, a biohazard warning sign printed on it. No text.
shots.narration: 把袋子提出来，用耐高压的专用袋。
overlay: 外表消毒、换手套，再移出柜外

shots.section_title: 外表消毒、换手套，再移出柜外
shots.scene: 袋子外面和空桶外壁擦消毒剂，计时
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the outer bag surface and the empty bin wall wiped with disinfectant, with a timer icon. No text.
shots.narration: 袋子外面、空桶外壁都消毒，等够时间。

shots.section_title: 外表消毒、换手套，再移出柜外
shots.scene: 柜内脱下外层手套，换新手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the outer pair of gloves removed inside the cabinet and fresh gloves put on. No text.
shots.narration: 柜内脱掉外层手套，换干净手套。

shots.section_title: 外表消毒、换手套，再移出柜外
shots.scene: 直接拎袋出柜带出污染，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dirty-gloved hand pulling an unwiped bag out of the cabinet; crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 脏手套拎着脏袋出柜，污染就带出来。

shots.section_title: 外表消毒、换手套，再移出柜外
shots.scene: 袋子放进柜外的废物盘，一起移走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places the bag into a tray outside the cabinet and carries them away.
shots.narration: 放进柜外废物盘，一起移走。

shots.section_title: 送去灭菌：袋口按灭菌规程处理
shots.scene: 废物袋送到高压灭菌器旁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the waste bag in a tray carried to an autoclave. No text.
shots.narration: 柜内废物，按规程送去灭菌。
overlay: 送去灭菌：袋口按灭菌规程处理

shots.section_title: 送去灭菌：袋口按灭菌规程处理
shots.scene: 蒸汽钻进松口袋，扎死的袋子中心打问号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: steam entering a loosely closed bag, while a tightly sealed bag has a question mark in its center. No text.
shots.narration: 扎得太死，蒸汽进不去，可能灭不透。

shots.section_title: 送去灭菌：袋口按灭菌规程处理
shots.scene: 规程书：加水、松口按灭菌规程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a procedure book with icons for adding water and loosening the bag neck before sterilizing. No text.
shots.narration: 加不加水、怎么松口，按灭菌规程。

shots.section_title: 送去灭菌：袋口按灭菌规程处理
shots.scene: 灭菌后交有资质单位处置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an autoclaved bag handed over to a licensed waste collection truck with a record sheet. No text.
shots.narration: 灭菌后，再按医疗废物交接处置。

shots.section_title: 风机再运行，关灯关窗，签登记
shots.scene: 风机继续运行，计时器转动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the empty clean cabinet keeps running with a timer icon. No text.
shots.narration: 清理完，风机再运行一会儿换净空气。
overlay: 风机再运行，关灯关窗，签登记

shots.section_title: 风机再运行，关灯关窗，签登记
shots.scene: 依次关灯、关风机、关前窗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off the light, then the fan, then closes the sash.
shots.narration: 然后关灯、关风机，最后关好前窗。

shots.section_title: 风机再运行，关灯关窗，签登记
shots.scene: 风机常开的实验室：只关灯，前窗开着
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cabinet whose fan stays on all the time; only the light is switched off and the sash stays open. No text.
shots.narration: 风机常开的，只关灯，前窗不关。

shots.section_title: 风机再运行，关灯关窗，签登记
shots.scene: 紫外灯亮，人离开房间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ultraviolet lamp on inside the closed cabinet while people leave the room. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外灯只作辅助，开灯时人要离开。

shots.section_title: 风机再运行，关灯关窗，签登记
shots.scene: 小研在使用登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs the cabinet usage log.
shots.narration: 有使用登记的，记得签字。

shots.section_title: 定期检测认证，维护职责分明
shots.scene: 检测机构人员给柜子做检测
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests the cabinet airflow with measuring instruments.
shots.narration: 每台柜子都要定期检测认证。
overlay: 定期检测认证，维护职责分明

shots.section_title: 定期检测认证，维护职责分明
shots.scene: 新装、移位、到期三个图标指向检测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons for a new cabinet, a moved cabinet and an expiry calendar all point to a test. No text.
shots.narration: 新装、搬动后和到期，都要检测。

shots.section_title: 定期检测认证，维护职责分明
shots.scene: 【实拍】检测合格标签特写，有效期一栏（信息后期打码）
shots.prompt_en: A close view of a cabinet inspection label with its validity field. No readable text.
shots.narration: 检测过期的柜子，停用，先别用。

shots.section_title: 定期检测认证，维护职责分明
shots.scene: 清洁维护计划表：日常清洁和专业维修两栏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a maintenance plan with a daily cleaning column and a professional repair column. No text.
shots.narration: 日常清洁有规程，维修换过滤器找专业人员。

shots.section_title: 定期检测认证，维护职责分明
shots.scene: 拿不准就问学院和学校安全部门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the safety administrator a question.
shots.narration: 拿不准，就问学院和学校安全部门。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 风机开着、盖好容器、由轻到重擦
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a running fan, closed containers and items wiped from least to most contaminated. No text.
shots.narration: 风机开着，盖好容器，由轻到重擦。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 双层袋扎紧、外表消毒、换手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a double bag tied, its surface wiped and gloves changed. No text.
shots.narration: 四分之三封口，双层扎紧，消毒换手套。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 灭菌、登记、定期检测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons for an autoclave, a signed log and an inspection label. No text.
shots.narration: 送去灭菌，签登记，定期检测。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣穿着隔离衣、戴手套挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears an isolation gown and gloves and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：生物实验个人防护装备。
